title: Expose stale links when design content changes
preconditions: Use livingFixture checkout/fast with the two design-pinned relations from createDeliveryItem.

steps.action: Replace checkout-design content with revised design text and reopen the session.
steps.expected_result: The design digest differs from the relation pins.
Both dependent relations are returned with reason content digest changed.

expected_result: Changed design content makes dependent pins visibly stale.
